_brief: Item 13 TO EDIT, variation 1 - the FAST one (~28s): five short, joyful answers, different people from variation 2. Opens on the young woman whose brother just proposed (Hebrew, read by two models), the strongest (grandmother: another granddaughter, TODAY) 3rd, ends on the older man's 'every day you get up, say thank you. Amen.' NO ZOOMS (LESSONS 80). The host here is the red-haired guy holding the sign, not Tal; his questions are cut wherever the answer stands alone.
beats: HOOK: young woman (Hebrew) 'my brother proposed!' - 'really?' - 'yes!' and she laughs
young man: 'I left college to be here. It was not easy. I'm just happy to be here.'
STRONGEST, grandmother in the sun hat: 'my good news for today?'
...'I have another granddaughter' - 'wow' - 'TODAY!' (hands up) - 'mazal tov' (1.4s pause trimmed for pace; same take, same framing)

man with the kippah, pink shorts: 'I'm so lucky to be alive - I'm in Israel right now, the best place you could possibly be' (replaces the boy in the red cap: LESSONS 81, a stranger's child is not shown; a blurred face would have been the whole beat)
ENDING, older man in the pink shirt: '...a good day that you're alive. So every day that you get up, you should say thank you. Amen.'
